scope: Additive Action Figure L1-27 and spawned Giant Giant audit, separating permanent Equipment summon from temporary event-troop values.
game_version: Official 2025-04 Equipment release, 2026-01 Giant Giant AI note and 2026-09 separate temporary troop; claimed client build 18.600.3 for dated Equipment bonus table; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: The Friend or Foe Medal Event is here!
facts: Action Figure is new Epic Archer Queen Equipment and summons a temporary troop to fight by her side.
sources.limitations: The article does not give spawned-unit stats, behavior, count, Queen invisibility or tick order. Event availability does not make the Equipment temporary.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
facts: Supercell says Giant Giant AI was changed so it is less prioritized by Warden or Eagle.
sources.limitations: The note does not explicitly distinguish the Equipment-spawned Giant Giant from the separately available event troop, quantify priority or define an algorithm.

sources.title: Equipment Blast Medal Event
facts: The September event independently lists temporary Giant Giant and previously released permanent Action Figure Equipment.
sources.limitations: Its event-troop 50 housing-space, approximate tenfold stats, Spring Trap immunity and rage description are not explicitly attached to the Equipment spawn and are not imported as child rules.

sources.title: Action Figure — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The public L1-27 Queen HP, DPS and cost table matches pinned fields, including L27 HP 713 and DPS bonus 135; the page names Giant Giant as the summon.
sources.limitations: The public table omits child level, child stats, self-heal rate and invisibility.

sources.title: Friend or Foe Event
facts: The release report explicitly describes Action Figure as an active Queen Equipment summoning a Giant Giant.
sources.limitations: The page also describes a separate time-limited Giant Giant troop; it does not prove identical child stats or AI.

sources.title: Pinned Action Figure Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The payload preserves per-level giantGiantLevel, Queen selfHealingPerSecond, DPS and HP bonuses, and a one-second invisibilityDuration.
sources.limitations: It does not define child HP/DPS, spawn placement, targeting, current effect continuity or invisibility target-loss order.

observations.note: Historical Equipment fields only; the raw payload gives no child stat table or complete Core contract.
Permanent Equipment requires a Giant Giant child actor. No current child stat or collision data is imported from separate temporary event troops.

derivations.result: Retain Giant Giant child level and Queen bonuses as data-only
derivations.method: Pin all per-level fields to the immutable raw payload; cross-check Queen HP/DPS and Equipment identity against the dated 2026 table.

derivations.result: Add a separate partial spawned-unit coverage row
derivations.method: Official Equipment release plus dated launch report establish a summoned troop named Giant Giant; do not merge with the temporary event troop stat contract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply September 2026 temporary Giant Giant housing space, approximate 10x stats, rage or Spring Trap immunity to the Equipment child
rejected_inferences.reason: The source presents separate temporary event troop content and does not explicitly state stat/AI inheritance for Action Figure summons.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the January 2026 less-prioritized AI note as a deterministic target-weight formula
rejected_inferences.reason: No numerical weight, eligibility or tie-break is given, and the note does not distinguish event from summoned variants.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Queen self healing from deployment with a 10 ms fractional accumulator
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw rate lacks an activation start, rounding and HP-cap phase contract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Give the spawned Giant Giant the Queen's one-second invisibility
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw field does not identify child invisibility or its start/end phase.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn one Giant Giant at a fixed offset on the activation tick
rejected_inferences.reason: Child count is implied by singular description, but exact spawn position, collision and tick ordering are not documented.

items: current Giant Giant L1-10 mapping, Queen self-heal and one-second invisibility continuity
whether Queen self healing is passive or activation-limited
Queen HP/DPS stacking, healing cap and death tick order
activation, spawn and Queen invisibility start/end ticks
Viewer art, snapshot, replay and RL activation
current child HP, DPS, cadence, range, movement, footprint and hitbox
relationship to separately temporary Giant Giant troop and January 2026 AI change
spawn position, collision and entity-ID order
defense targeting, splash, rage, Wall and trap interactions
lifetime, Queen defeat, Pet/aura effects and battlefield art rights

conclusion: Action Figure L1-27 and its Giant Giant child remain partial and catalogue-only. Sourced release establishes the permanent Queen summon; child stats, identity relationship to temporary event content, geometry, healing and tick order remain unresolved.
